text:
Conflict card for tower_a:

Input: fire_alarm is true and seismic is true.

Rule A - "A fire alarm sends the elevator to the ground floor." triggers and requires action ground_floor.

Rule B - "Seismic mode stops at the nearest floor." triggers and requires action nearest_floor.

The actions ground_floor and nearest_floor are incompatible and cannot both be done.

Which rule wins?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
